selection: Four newest signatures per program per epoch in returned order. No success-based expansion, replacements, filtering, provider switching or follow-up search.
duplicates: Retain every selection position. Report duplicate signatures separately; fetch each selected position including duplicates.
failures: Retain raw HTTP/RPC errors, nulls and unavailable positions. Failed signature rows are fetched, not discarded. Missing list positions are explicit unavailable selections.

retry.longRetryAfter: If server Retry-After exceeds10 seconds, do not retry this request; retain error. Same request only.

perspective: First transaction signer for every available response. This is public fixture context, not connected personal-wallet ownership. Sponsored/multi-signer perspective limitations are retained.
evaluation: Unchanged current production Dart normalizeDirectActivity; no app/lib/model/parser changes. Supported results additionally checked from exact route/authority/owned endpoints/program/balances/atomic deltas.
scope: Public RPC fixture at current version, not current owner live app flow, no new signature/trade/asset movement. Program sampling is not representative/general accuracy or independent human validation.
